description: This file defines the interface CollectionSheetReadPlatformService which provides methods for generating collection sheet data for individual, group, and center collections in a microloan or microfinance system.

classes.name: CollectionSheetReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for generating collection sheet data for different entity types.

methods.name: generateGroupCollectionSheet
methods.description: Generates collection sheet data for a specific group based on group ID and query parameters.

methods.name: generateCenterCollectionSheet
methods.description: Generates collection sheet data for a specific center based on group ID and query parameters.

methods.name: generateIndividualCollectionSheet
methods.description: Generates collection sheet data for an individual based on query parameters.
